holds.name: typescript
holds.reason: vue-tsc 3.3.14 (peer typescript >=5.0.0) type-checks the docs app and drives the TypeScript 5/6 compiler API from the package's main export; the typescript 7.x package (latest 7.0.2, next 7.1.0-dev.20261104.1) exports only ./lib/version.cjs at "." plus the new typescript/sync, typescript/async, typescript/ast and typescript/proto API, which vue-tsc and twoslash 0.3.9 do not use. 6.0.3 is the newest 6.x release. Re-test on every sweep: the hold ends when vue-tsc runs on the typescript 7 API.
